<figure class="reference-portrait"><a href="/images/spider-v016.webp"><img src="/images/spider-v016.webp" alt="Mire Spider — staged in-game portrait" width="1600" height="900" /></a><figcaption>Actual game model, staged for this portrait in v0.16.0.</figcaption></figure>

Keeps its distance, spits slowing webs, then darts in to bite. Venom prevents healing. Bring Bogwalker’s Balm to protect against venom and webs.

## Health and poise

| Level | Variant | Easy / Builder health | Normal health | Hard / Hardcore health | Poise |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Mire Spider | 46 | 50.6 | 59.8 | 22 |
| 2 | Mire Spider | 66.7 | 73.37 | 86.71 | 22 |
| 3 | Bog Weaver | 87.4 | 96.14 | 113.62 | 22 |

These are non-elite values before omens. Poise does not scale with creature level or difficulty. In the outer lands (Birchwood, the Mire, the Highlands, Elderwood and the coast) creatures have **×1.3 health**, **×1.15 poise** and **×1.2 damage**, notice heroes from 15% further, move 5% faster and are 60% more often elites; packs of Stalkers and spiders there hold one more. Base movement speed: **5.6 m/s**, before night, state, omen and elite modifiers.

## Attacks

| Attack | Base damage | Normal, level 1 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bite | 11 | 12.32 |
| Web impact | 4 | 4.48 |

Damage = base × (1 + 0.3 × (level − 1)) × difficulty multiplier. Easy/Builder: ×1; Normal: ×1.12; Hard/Hardcore: ×1.35. This is outgoing hit damage before the hero’s armour, mitigation and other combat effects. Venom and grave rot are separate status effects.

## Damage types

| Kind of blow | Damage taken | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Crushing (clubs, fists) | ×1.5 | Weak |
| Cutting (blades, axes) | ×0.7 | Resists |
| Piercing (spears, arrows, picks) | ×1 | Normal |

A blow on a creature that has not noticed anyone is a **sneak attack**: ×3 damage, at most once every 5 minutes per creature. Exposed creatures take ×1.6 on top. See [Sneaking and damage types](/mechanics/#sneaking-and-damage-types).

## Elite and warden modifiers

Elite health is multiplied by 1.6, poise by 1.3 and outgoing damage by 1.15. Ironhide adds ×1.8 health and ×1.6 poise; Frenzied adds ×1.35 damage; Swift adds ×1.3 movement speed. Barrow wardens also apply their own health multiplier, ×1.6 poise and ×1.2 damage. These effects stack.

Elite loot is **additional** to the normal drops: one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/stalker-trophy/"><img src="/images/icons/stalkertrophy.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Stalker Trophy</a>, two <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/hide/"><img src="/images/icons/hide.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Raw Hide</a>, plus one <a class="entity-link" href="/equipment/items/crystal/"><img src="/images/icons/crystal.png" alt="" width="40" height="40" loading="lazy" />Echo Crystal</a> with 65% / 80% / 95% chance at level 1 / 2 / 3. The game uses the Stalker trophy for elite spiders too. Omens can add further drops.
